name: Bracers of Rock Binding
summary: Bracers of Rock Binding are stone bindings taken from greater rock elementals in the Badlands. Lotwil Veriatus needs them to measure the strength of his own shackles.

sections.title: Stone Bindings
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus studies the greater rock elementals in the Badlands for the elemental shackles he is building. He believes their bracers can help him gauge how strong his own shackles are. Five will give him spares for his research, since his assistant Servo is known to misplace reagents and notes.

faq.q: What are the Bracers of Rock Binding?
faq.answer: They are stone bracers taken from greater rock elementals in the Badlands. Lotwil Veriatus studies them to gauge the strength of his own shackles.
Lotwil Veriatus wants five Bracers of Rock Binding for his research into the strength of his shackles.
Lotwil Veriatus believes the greater rock elementals' bracers will help him measure the strength of his own shackles.

faq.q: Where do the bracers come from?
faq.answer: Greater rock elementals in the Badlands carry Bracers of Rock Binding.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil ask for five?
faq.answer: Lotwil asks for five so he has extras for his research, as his assistant Servo is notorious for misplacing reagents and research.
